# Commit Guidance

## Title

- Keep the title short and concise.
- Describe the impact of the changes without implementation detail.
- State the outcome directly, such as fixing a bug or adding a feature.
- Keep each commit focused on one coherent change.

## Description

- Follow the title with a description written as a bullet list.
- Use one bullet for each specific change included in the commit.
- Make the bullets explain and substantiate the impact stated in the title.
- Include technical detail in the bullets when it helps a future reader understand the change.
